text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold issue in cli/commands/init.py was identified in developer tooling.","The corrupted scaffold problem only occurred for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys.","The symptom of the issue was a missing file in the generated tree.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query, submitted as PR #3097 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1.","The issue could be reproduced by running init into a directory that already has a lockfile.","After the fix, memory usage improved from climbing past 3 GB to settling at 449 MB."]}
